recommended_operating.conditions: CN104 pin 3, '3.3 V (sensor power supply)'; supplied from the Arduino 3.3 V pin through the Shield (JP1 pin 1)
MMR920C04 operating range (digital output micro pressure sensor)

pins.name: SCL
pins.notes: CN104 pin 1, I2C clock, 'Connected to SCL pin of the sensor' (p11). 100 kohm pull-up R104 to VDD on the board (p15 schematic, p20 BOM). I2C address 0xCE(W)/0xCF(R) (8-bit, p10) = 0x67 7-bit.

pins.name: SDA
pins.notes: CN104 pin 2, I2C data, 'Connected to SDA pin of the sensor' (p11). 100 kohm pull-up R103 to VDD on the board (p15, p20).

pins.name: VDD
pins.notes: CN104 pin 3, 3.3 V sensor power supply (p11). On the board it feeds both MMR920 VDD and VDDIO, decoupled by C107 10 uF and C108 0.1 uF (p15, p20).

pins.name: DRDYB
pins.notes: Through-hole TH104, 'Digital output (Data Ready signal)', not on the 4-pin I2C connector; connect only to use DRDYB/DRDY (p11, p15). Unused in this design.

layout_notes.text: Board connector CN104 is a Seeed 'Grove Female Header DIP-4Pin-2.0mm' with pinout 1=SCL, 2=SDA, 3=VDD, 4=GND;
On-board parts: C107 10 uF (GRM188R61E106KA73D), C108 0.1 uF (CGA3E2X7R1H104K080AA), R103/R104 100 kohm (I2C pull-ups), U104 MMR920. PSEL of U104 tied to GND (I2C mode).
MMR920 PSEL pin tied to GND, CSB and SDO not connected on the I2C board (schematic).
Kit caution: design/sales promotion tool, Mitsumi gives no guarantee of performance or reliability for the kit boards.

gaps: MMR920 chip datasheet (MMR920_DATASHEET_Ver.X.X, referenced p10) is not available: no supply voltage range, no absolute maximum ratings, no supply current, no I2C VIL/VIH/VOL, no I2C speed, no power-up timing. The 3.3 V value is the kit's nominal supply only (p11).
I2C address given as 8-bit 0xCE(W)/0xCF(R) (p10); 0x67 is its 7-bit form. No address-select option documented.
VOL / sink capability of the MMR920 SDA output not given;
No absolute maximum on the I2C pins or VDD at board level.
Ordering name in the kit is 'MMR920C04A I2C Board' (PO EASR920C04A-B1, p22); the 'C04' vs 'C04A' suffix is to confirm with the purchased board.
Pin types for SCL (input) are from the connector function 'I2C' and sensor pin name SCLK/SCL; direction not stated explicitly.
